hotels.title: Vietnam Golf Escape near Da Nang with Massages, Daily Breakfast, Two Golf Rounds & Airport Transfers
hotels.description: Tee off, kick back and unwind between jungle-topped mountains and golden shores at Angsana Lang Co, a must-visit for golf lovers in Vietnam. This secluded oasis is set on a private beach on the central coast between Da Nang and Hue, and is part of the greater Laguna Lang Co integrated resort. Golfers can take to the greens at Laguna Golf Lang Co, an 18-hole, par-71 championship course designed by Sir Nick Faldo, with two rounds included. Guests also enjoy access to neighbouring sister properties, meaning there's always more to discover, from wellness facilities to a plethora of restaurants and bars. Refuel with upscale dining and soothe sore muscles with a treatment at the indulgent Angsana Spa. A sprawling lagoon pool wraps around the resort - the ideal place to enjoy balmy afternoons with a cocktail - while the warm waters of the East Sea invite moments of stillness beside lapping waves.

hotels.title: Central Vietnam Private Pool Villas with Two Rounds of Golf, Daily Breakfast & Two Lunches or Dinners
hotels.description: World-class golf meets five-star luxury at this exclusive stay in the heart of Vietnam. Check into the stunning Banyan Tree Lang Co for pool villa luxury - tucked in a white-sand bay between Hue, Da Nang and Hoi An - and enjoy two rounds of golf at one of the country's finest courses. Relax, indulge and navigate the fairways of Laguna Golf Lang Co, an 18-hole championship course designed by Sir Nick Faldo, where dramatic mountain backdrops meet the sparkling waters of Lang Co Bay. When you're off the course, the resort has plenty to offer - unwind at the dreamy spa, join a Vietnamese cooking class or greet the morning with sunrise yoga on the beach.
